scenes.title: Tracks Into the Fort
scenes.rationale: The party's approach, the ankheg ambush, and the immediate investigation of its burrow form one continuous sequence before the party turns to the temple and towers.

scenes.title: Sanctuary and Spoils
scenes.rationale: The party rests and investigates the fort's temple and towers in a distinct aboveground interlude that ends with the decision to descend below.

scenes.title: Stone Trails Below
scenes.rationale: The statue, cockatrice nursery, and cistern are successive discoveries in one continuous underground exploration following the obsidian trail.

scenes.title: Battle for the Obsidian
scenes.rationale: The skeleton assault and the emergence of the obsidian staff-bearer are two phases of the same uninterrupted combat.

scenes.title: Breaking the Staff
scenes.rationale: The post-battle study leads directly to the decision and repeated attempts to destroy the staff, culminating after the overnight rest.
